finding: Five collapsed preferences are the same copper-to-amber increment zeroed by pooled squared hinge plus ridge, despite three explicit positive single-step training examples in offending fold.
fix: Add training-only single-feature strict margin>=1e-4 to existing hard-equality global fit. Numerical positive sign safeguard, not meaningful premium or dollars.
older_tie_diagnosis: Requires exact identity vintage35-vintage40 + tare115-tare120 = shadeAmber-shadeBrown. Other two equalities constrain a different combination (25/30,125/115,copper/amber). When this unique family is withheld there is no hard equality requiring the older identity. Full fit can represent it, but heldout residual varies in sign. This is evidence support/transfer limitation, not demonstrated representational impossibility. Do not impose equality from heldout answer.
decision: Keep positive-sign guarded model as improved experimental ranking candidate. No default premium model replacement; older tie generalization remains unsolved.
